title_vi: Tám chiến lược đẩy khóa ra, và Redis thật sự có những gì

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a git fetch of the pinned commit and hashed as a Git blob; computed OID matches the source map. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Mô phỏng các chính sách đẩy khóa ra trên ba kiểu truy cập.
memcached dùng LRU chia vùng thay cho các chính sách của Redis.

claims.evidence: Redis eviction doc, memcached new_lru.txt and Microsoft's caching guidance read from local clones; eviction policies tested on Redis 7.0.15.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson (Markdown to HTML, optional sections open, 16 px side gutters) at each width: no horizontal overflow of the page or of any table; figure drawn by scripts/figures (viewBox width 320, smallest font 15 px) shown at 13.5 px effective at 320 px and 15 px at 375 px; every SVG text box inside the viewBox. python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser passed. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: maxmemory-policy values include noeviction (writes error when full), allkeys-lru, allkeys-lfu, allkeys-random, volatile-lru, volatile-lfu, volatile-random and volatile-ttl; volatile policies behave like noeviction if no keys have an expiration; LRU and LFU are approximated and maxmemory-samples tunes LRU; consider two separate instances when one Redis serves both cache and persistent keys.
claims.section: Eviction policies; Approximated LRU algorithm; LFU eviction
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of redis/docs at commit 3b030c7ef066c0bb7f88ddec02c784e49783b0f8, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: memcached splits its LRU into HOT, WARM and COLD to protect active items from scanning.
claims.verified_by: Read from a clone of memcached/memcached at tag 1.6.24 (commit 1b3b8555734f9b7b8d979924c7f8d6cf82194ba8), the version that was run.

claims.claim_vi: A private cache is held locally by each application instance and a shared cache is a common source for many; local copies held by different instances can become inconsistent.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036, the head of its default branch when read on 2026-10-18 (a later change to that branch does not alter this URL).

claims.claim_vi: Redis 7.0.15, maxmemory 4mb (about 2,950 keys of 1000 bytes), 60,000 reads, hit ratios lru/lfu/random: Zipf 78.8/81.2/77.4%; 70% to 1,500 hot keys plus one-off keys 55.1/67.3/51.0%; loop over 6,000 keys 16.8/31.2/19.7%; lru with maxmemory-samples 10 on Zipf 78.8%; noeviction 8,981 OOM errors; volatile-lru with no expiring keys the same 8,981 errors; volatile-ttl with TTL 600 hit 76.7% and 11,172 evictions.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one KVM virtual machine (4 vCPU): raw RESP client in Python, Zipf distribution with exponent 1.

claims.claim_vi: Eight strategies: LRU, MRU, SLRU, LFU, FIFO, TTL, two-tiered caching, random replacement.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung ghi chú: tám tên đối chiếu với Redis, kết quả thử, và hai bẫy cấu hình. Bảng đối chiếu đầy đủ nằm trong bài.
source_deviations: Source describes eight abstract strategies; the lesson maps each to Redis's maxmemory-policy (or notes that Redis lacks it) and tests them on a real server, including two configurations that make writes fail.
Two-tiered caching is described as able to cut latency for hits in the local tier, not as fastest: the lesson did not measure it, and a local tier with few hits adds a lookup to every read.
